# PR #1184: R26.12 B16 round 2 (bead 22fffb20). Release-gate verdict, re-issue after the body-only edit

This verdict supersedes `verdict-1184.md` (MERGE-WITH-CHANGES at the same head). That verdict had one required change, a body-only edit, plus a CI precondition. Both are now satisfied. The code is unchanged: the head is still `b85b467ee2fa932ebf7d9a74d69e12bf8c59112b` (read back with `gh pr view 1184 --json headRefOid`). Every code-level finding in `verdict-1184.md` therefore stands as verified:
- items 1–3 proven red by mutation;
- 2923 passed at head and 3013 passed merged with main `2a20a1b6`;
- invariants pass, ruff is clean at the CI pin, console 358 passed;
- scope is clean.

## Required change 1 (PR body) — read back and confirmed

Command: `gh pr view 1184 --json body -q .body`, saved to `gate-1181/body-1184.txt`.

- Line 81 reads: "Collected tests (`cd apps/factory-dispatcher && python -m pytest tests/ --collect-only -q`): 2904 at merge base f9d8a8f4, 2923 at head b85b467e (+19 for this PR; +11 of them in round 2, over PR 1181's 2912)." It is followed by an outer-loop correction note. These counts match the gate's recount: 2904 at f9d8a8f, 2923 at b85b467e.
- The corpus line is retained: 367, with its command. The gate's `git ls-files apps/factory-dispatcher/tasks/ | grep -c '\.json$'` also gives 367.
- `grep -c '^Change kind:'` returns 1 (line 12: `Change kind: behavioral`), which matches the behavioral diff.

## Merge instructions

- Merge `b85b467ee2fa932ebf7d9a74d69e12bf8c59112b` through `scripts/merge-pr.sh`, not a bare `gh pr merge --squash`.
- The PR is not the base of another PR, so `--delete-branch` is not a hazard here. Still, check `gh pr list --json number,baseRefName` first.
- Any push, rebase or force-push to the branch voids this verdict; the tested tree must be the merged tree.
- No merge order constraint applies. Main's move to `2a20a1b6` (B2b) does not overlap this PR's files, and the local merge `270e7cc` passed the full suite (3013 passed).
